evals.prompt: /proto the pricing card on our marketing page — I can't decide what direction it should take.
evals.expected_output: Scopes to the single piece, reads VISION.md, the tokens and the existing components, names three directions with an axis each (never Option A/B/C), builds one index.html in prototypes/<slug>/ with every control working, copies switcher.js next to it with cp instead of retyping it, re-reads the page once, says "not rendered" when no browser tool is available, then hands over the Variant / Axis / Right when / Costs you table and stops without picking a favourite.
expectations: Proposes 3 directions by default, each with a sentence-case descriptive name and a stated axis; none is a tint of another
Builds only in prototypes/<slug>/, touches no production code, and copies switcher.js with cp rather than retyping or editing it
Every control in every variant does something: no lorem, no dead buttons, no autofocus
Says "not rendered" when no browser tool is available, instead of installing tools or writing scripts outside the repo
Ends with the Variant / Axis / Right when / Costs you table and how to flip the switcher, then stops with no favourite picked

evals.prompt: riff Quiet — but I want the calm direction explored harder
evals.expected_output: Keeps the copied switcher, builds a fresh set of variants around the Quiet direction (each with a new name and stated axis), and again hands over the trade-off table and stops for the user's choice.
expectations: Keeps the existing switcher and prototype folder instead of starting the whole workflow over
New variants diverge around the named direction on stated axes; none is a tint of another
The switcher file stays an unchanged copy of switcher.js
Ends with the trade-off table and waits for the user's pick

evals.expected_output: Integrates the Editorial variant with the project's existing components, tokens and conventions, keeps anything the contract lacks out and proposes those rows in chat, deletes the prototype with rm -r prototypes/<slug> (never git), writes a decided entry to FEEDBACK.md naming the winner and each losing direction with its axis, and offers to draft the short contract rows, leaving VISION.md as it is.
expectations: Integrates the chosen variant using the project's existing components, tokens and conventions
Proposes any token or timing the contract lacks as a row in chat and does not write VISION.md
Deletes the prototype folder with rm -r, never with git
Writes a DECIDED entry to FEEDBACK.md in its dated format (date, DECIDED, who picked) naming the winner and the directions that lost, with their axes
Offers to draft the short contract rows the winner implies
